note: On the Tunnel Mountain bench above Banff, with a public transit stop to town; laid out for trailers and larger units. Campfires are not permitted. --Claude
summary: Keep. 2026 season May 7 - Oct 5 (stored May 1 - Oct 7 was approximate); 322 full-hookup sites to 50 ft at C$47.25; electric is 15/30 amp per the page, so 50 -> 30; showers, dump, flush toilets and drinking water added; pin sits in the trailer-court grid.
flags: hookups.electric 50 -> 30: the Banff camping page says 'Full service sites with 15 and 30 AMPS' for the Trailer Court (50 amp is named only for Village II and Lake Louise). The stored 50 came from note prose.
Note: stored 'Short walk to Banff townsite' dropped; the page puts neighbouring Village I 4.5 km from town.
PIN: no move. Stored 51.19055,-115.53436 falls in the middle of the trailer court's A/B/C grid on imagery (z15) and on the 2026 campground map.
PHONE: entry has none; the pages give only the reservation line 1-877-737-3783 (and Banff Dispatch 403-762-1470 for wildlife reports). apply.py does not write phone.

Agency rows: the entry inherits the generic `federal` row's booking platform (recreation.gov), 180-day window and the US interagency senior/access discount; none applies to Parks Canada. Platform left unset here because the schema's list has no value for the Parks Canada Reservation Service; the reservation window is not stated on the pages read.
